purpose: W9-C: replace process-local notification/read state and hard-coded delivery assumptions with a PostgreSQL inbox, versioned templates, outbox-driven delivery attempts/receipts, user preferences, quiet hours and mandatory-event exceptions.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.
requiredInvariants: The notification inbox/read state is PostgreSQL-authoritative and tenant/user scoped; restart or another instance observes the same rows and read acknowledgements.

Notifications originate from accepted domain/outbox events or explicit operator/system commands with authoritative source references. Template names that imply payment, signature, EDO, KYC or delivery success cannot create such success without the source event proving it.
Template definitions are versioned, localized RU/EN/ZH, effective-dated and content-hashed. A historical notification pins the exact template version and rendered source facts.
Delivery to in-app/email/SMS/push/other channels is a separate attempt/receipt lifecycle. Creating an inbox item is not proof an external channel delivered it.

Preferences are user-scoped and versioned. Quiet hours suppress/defer only optional notifications; mandatory security/legal/deadline events explicitly marked non-suppressible still create inbox/delivery obligations according to policy.
No process-local array/Map may be production delivery/read authority. Capacity limits use retention/archive policy instead of silently deleting the oldest 500 records.
Mark-read/mark-all-read require current user authority and idempotently append/update read evidence without allowing one user to acknowledge another user's notification.

Every notification stores source event/object, type, severity/priority, required action/deadline if present and route/deep-link target as data; free-form title/message never becomes the only business evidence.
Delivery retries use durable attempts, exponential/backoff policy, terminal failure/dead-letter state and receipts. A failed channel does not erase the inbox item or source event.
Same-tenant/cross-tenant leakage through bulk listing/counting is denied. Staff broadcast/mandatory notices require separate explicit staff authority and audience snapshot.
No notification action mutates Deal, money, signature, external integration or Role Eligibility state; it only surfaces or acknowledges information.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, domain authorities, external provider credentials and REG.RU topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Regression proves NotificationsService no longer uses process-local notification arrays for production inbox/read authority.
Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove create/list/read/mark-all, tenant/user isolation, idempotency and restart/second-instance consistency.
Template tests prove exact version/language rendering and reject a template that claims an external success without an accepted matching source event type/status.
Preference/quiet-hours tests prove optional delivery deferral and mandatory exception behavior while the in-app record remains durable.
Delivery tests prove attempt/retry/receipt/dead-letter semantics and distinguish queued/sent/delivered outcomes.
Retention tests archive/expire according to policy rather than silently truncating at a fixed process-memory count.
Notification UI shows loading/empty/error/read/unread/action/deadline and channel status without static/demo fallback facts.
Exact-head CI/review plus REG.RU restart/multi-instance/user-flow evidence are required before terminal notification credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Real external email/SMS/push providers, if used, require separate provider contracts/credentials/receipts; in-app can be completed without new mandatory recurring cost.
Settings W8-C must expose notification preferences/provenance after both authorities are accepted.
Deadline/exception engine W9-D supplies mandatory deadline/escalation events.
Real-user notification usability/noise acceptance remains later human acceptance.
